name: Web application firewall
description: Checks every request with the OWASP Core Rule Set (Coraza) before the wiki handles it, with the exclusions the wiki needs. Shipped but off: switch it on for installations without a firewall in front (the bundled proxy with CrowdSec, ModSecurity …). Mode: block (default) or log only.
author: Enterprise Wiki

permissions.label: Manage the web application firewall
permissions.description: Change mode and paranoia level of the web application firewall.

limits.label: Request body checked by the firewall
limits.help: The firewall checks at most this much of a request body; the rest is passed on unchecked (the wiki checks every input itself). File uploads are not checked by the firewall.
